function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
**Top‑ranked singles players (as of the most recent ATP/WTA rankings released in late September 2026)**  

| Category | Rank 1 | Notes |
|----------|--------|-------|
| **ATP (Men’s)** | **Novak Djokovic** | Holds the No. 1 spot on the ATP singles rankings. Djokovic has reclaimed the top position after a brief dip earlier in the season and is currently leading the points table. |
| **WTA (Women’s)** | **Iga Świątek** | The Polish star remains at the summit of the WTA singles rankings, having defended her title at the French Open and accumulated enough points to stay ahead of the rest of the field. |

> **Why it matters**  
> The ATP and WTA rankings are updated every Monday, reflecting the results of the previous week’s tournaments. While the rankings can shift quickly—especially after major events like the Grand Slams—the players listed above are the current leaders as of the latest update.
